paper_identity.title: Large deformation of the very neutron-rich nucleus 32Mg from intermediate-energy Coulomb excitation

cross_mass_significance: Discovers the collapse of the N=20 spherical magic number in 32Mg via intermediate-energy Coulomb excitation at RIKEN: establishes B(E2; 0+ -> 2+) = 454(78) e^2 fm^4 and large prolate deformation beta2 ~ 0.51, proving that the removal of valence protons from Ca to Mg quenches the monopole tensor force, triggering a 2p-2h intruder ground-state inversion and demonstrating that shell closures cannot be transferred across isospin domains.
